title: Casa de la Independencia Museum
geometryBasis: The mapped five-corner museum envelope is held in its original local frame. OpenStreetMap way 390842545 defines the site outline. The front roof follows Presidente Franco, and the second roof and open central garden court follow the city’s documented two-body arrangement. The historic alley line is independent context.
sectionBasis: The corner façade and 14 de Mayo gateway follow exact published public-domain Qualla originals. The corner view was published in 2008 and lacks an independently established exposure date. The older restoration is shown in early color photographs. The later recovery of the former stable property, alley paving, adjacent buildings and museum interior are outside the scope. The mapped outline establishes the exterior extents. Internal court edges, the unphotographed rear wing and gallery, roof rise, facade dimensions, and plinth and step grades are proportioned estimates. The 128 m original elevation field was sampled before floors and sections were chosen. No terrain leveling, masking or reference photo pixels are included.
